name: Ogasawara Chisa
source:
A deeply-tanned local girl.
Has same age as Hiroki, her childhood friend. Chisa's parents run a diving shop. 
To help her family out, she helps tourist to swim with dolphins and works part-time collecting mail from the underwater postbox.

"Once summer's over, I'll be left behind again."

[Edited from [url=http://moenovel.com/adventure-of-a-lifetime]English official Site[/url]]
